summary: Practise policy statements, forward guidance and media briefings for central banks. Explore the five-day course and its applied communication outputs.
lede: Central bank policy communication training helps monetary policy analysts and communications professionals explain decisions clearly and consistently. Participants practise drafting policy rate statements, translating technical reasoning into public-facing language, and preparing press briefing answers about inflation, interest rates and forecasts. They also work on conditional forward guidance, explaining uncertainty, and reviewing communication through audience feedback and evaluation scorecards.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare or review monetary policy announcements, brief senior decision-makers, or manage public and media responses to central bank decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with monetary policy decisions, central bank operations or financial communications is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use written policy materials and spreadsheet-based review.
